summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 4 new features: (1) Multi-image upload with primary selection, (2) Suggested contractor highlight on Results page, (3) Easter egg ZIP 70123 returns 'The Shirtless Handyman', (4) Portfolio page with admin CRUD. All 13 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: Multi-image upload correctly stores primary image in original_image and extras in additional_images array
Contractor search properly marks first contractor with is_suggested=true
Easter egg ZIP 70123 correctly returns 'The Shirtless Handyman' with is_easter_egg=true as first result
Regular ZIPs (e.g., 70112) do NOT return easter egg contractor
Portfolio CRUD properly requires admin authentication
Admin stats endpoint includes total_portfolio count
Suggested contractor card has 'Suggested for You' badge and 'Local Legend' badge for easter egg
Navbar has 'Our Work' link navigating to /portfolio
Homepage has 'See Our Work' section with button linking to /portfolio
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features tested: (1) Multi-image upload accepts up to 3 photos with primary selection - primary goes to original_image, extras to additional_images array. (2) Contractor search returns is_suggested=true on first contractor. (3) Easter egg: ZIP 70123 returns 'The Shirtless Handyman' (Ryan Mena) as first result with is_easter_egg=true and 'Local Legend' badge. (4) Portfolio page at /portfolio shows before/after photos with BeforeAfterSlider component. Admin can upload via /admin Portfolio tab. Public API at GET /api/portfolio.
